title: Slash placeholder
description: A plain stand-in for media on a dark page: a soft grey light falling from the upper right for full-bleed hero renders, a faint top-lit wash for art inside cards, a dim slate frame for photos and video, or a small ringed chip for avatars; size and radius come from the caller.
notes: decorative and aria-hidden: never draws the subject it replaces
the lit and card washes are foreground light, so they read on dark themes and turn to soft shadow on light ones
